title: Font Manager foundry names
description: How the raw foundry strings of a font's name table (manufacturer, trademark, copyright, designer) fold into one canonical foundry name. Names compare as keys: lower case, every run of characters that are not letters or digits made one space, the legal suffixes at the end dropped. foundries.json follows it.

suffixes.description: Legal-form words dropped from the end of a key (Inc, LLC, Ltd), as keys. Sorted, unique.

ignore.description: Keys that name no foundry ('the authors'); a leading * matches any start ('*project authors'). Sorted, unique.

patterns.description: Notices a foundry name is read from (name ID 7 then name ID 0), tried in order. Text matches without case, a space matches any run of white space or none, {years} one or more years (2011, 2015-2022, 2011, 2012), {*} any text, {name} the foundry name up to the first stop. Each pattern has exactly one {name}, at its end.

nameStops.description: Where every foundry name ends: the text from the first stop on is dropped ('Cyreal (www.cyreal.org)').

noticeStops.description: Where a name read from a notice ends as well ('Typomondo, with Reserved Font Name').

foundries.description: Canonical foundries. Sorted by name without case; no key (of a name or an alias) belongs to two foundries.

name.description: The canonical name, as the app shows it.

aliases.description: Raw names that fold into it, as fonts write them.
